text:
Situation: Chloroprocaine hydrochloride 20 mg/mL 20 mL vial supply is low at Corvale East with 8.1 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 18 days and Corvale General holds 15 days. The product is labeled Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and manufactured at HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show chloroprocaine hydrochloride is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. An earlier shortage was first posted on 2021-05-17 and has since been resolved. FDA inspection 1123748 at Fresenius Kabi USA LLC ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI with a classification letter dated 2024-05-22. A second inspection 1174894 at the same plant ended 2022-06-30 and was classified OAI with a classification letter dated 2024-04-30. The most recent inspection 1216183 ended 2023-08-24 and was classified VAI.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA. The issue is localized distribution imbalance. Corvale East is below target days on hand while sister sites have adequate stock.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 2 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 4 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Use alternate concentration 10 mg/mL from Fresenius Kabi USA LLC — requires pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation.
4. Use alternate concentration 20 mg/mL from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires pharmacist verification for dose and volume recalculation.

Not recommended: No action that assumes a current FDA-listed shortage or that changes clinical protocols without committee review.
